goal: Avoid deep-copying byte buffers on interpreter stack duplication and reordering opcodes
Protect against memory inflation and CPU overhead if future soft forks allow multi-kilobyte stack elements
agreement: Widespread objections favoring consensus bounds over interpreter optimizations
Penalizes current scripts for an attack that is consensus-invalid today (Yudis-bit)
Lifting consensus limits should be bounded by consensus rules instead of engine optimizations (darosior)
Omits other large-element CPU DoS vectors like byte scanning in IFDUP and VERIFY (jrakibi)
Suggests chunking signatures across standard elements instead of expanding element size limits (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: validation
why: P4 because it mitigates a speculative DoS vector that only exists if future soft forks relax element limits
Current consensus limits already strictly bound stack element sizes to 520 bytes
